correctness.rationale: Record-order decomposition is exact, conditional future-record probability is (1-u^r)/r, and the two-copy covariance identity gives strict negativity for every nondegenerate atomless product distribution. Uniform Beta moments and elementary telescoping reconstruct the harmonic identity for all n≥2. Exact rational independent enumeration agrees in 54 finite cases, and 98 additional n confirm the uniform identity; no infinite claim rests solely on enumeration.

value.rationale: Front cardinality and dominated hypervolume are two natural but mathematically different performance statistics of randomized two-objective point sets. A universal strict negative dependence sign across all continuous product marginal laws and an exact harmonic finite-sample magnitude cannot be obtained from their separate means or variances. The result supplies a reference null-model joint statistic and its asymptotic calibration, not an arbitrary finite slice or a normalization check.
